experiment_plan.primary_comparison: All 11 models on their shared successful prompts; do not treat failures as zero punctuation
experiment_plan.supplementary_comparison: Report translated_zh and new_en subsets separately; optionally compare the paired translated subset against prior Chinese responses, using identical prompt pairs common to all models
experiment_plan.sampling: One complete response per model/prompt; only retry technical incompleteness, never punctuation-dependent

metric_protocol: Identical score/prose/aggregate/Wilson/paired-bootstrap implementation to parent benchmark; scripts validated by SHA-256.
language_label_note: Language labels refer to the input prompt. Answers are not filtered by detected language.
combined_en_note: Descriptive union of the prior English MT-Bench common prompts and this extension common prompts; a heterogeneous mixture, not an official benchmark score. Subsets must also be reported separately.

paired_translation_comparison.note: Same source situations, English adaptations versus prior Chinese answers. Single samples, translated wording and collection time may affect results; exploratory, not a pure causal language effect.
